# Trying Lolly for the first time

Open [Lolly](https://lolly.tools/) when the facilitator asks you to begin. They will give you one task at a time and help set up a separate browser profile. No account is needed. Northstar, the company in the tasks, is fictional.

Work as you normally would. Say what you expect to happen, what surprises you, and when you would normally stop or look for help. You can ask for help, skip a task, or stop at any time. We are checking how understandable Lolly is.

The facilitator will supply any files a task needs when you reach it. Keep the browser profile available until the close-and-reopen tasks are finished.
